name: Scott's Ferry General Store & Campground
evidence: satellite (Esri, 260 m frame) at 30.2884,-85.1445: RV sites on open grass ~55 m east of the Chipola River, with the campground loop road and a continuous strip of bank trees between them and the water; only the dock and boat launch reach the river (operator map agrees) - not waterfront; riverview candidate if a leaf-on sightline is ever confirmed
